conventions.convention: The metric has signature (−,+,+,+); u is future unit timelike, g(u,u)=−1. The spatial projector is h_a{}^b=δ_a{}^b+u_a u^b. Symmetrization includes the factor 1/2, and shear subtracts θh_ab/3.
Length coordinates use x⁰=ct. Physical heat flux is q=cQ; the closures are Q=−κX/c, Π=−ζ_b cθ, and π^{ab}=−2ηcσ^{ab}, with κ, η and ζ_b nonnegative.

The static metric is g=−N²(dx⁰)²+Σ_i(dxⁱ)² on R×U, with smooth positive lapse bounded above and away from zero on the closed rectangular box. Redshifted temperature is ϑ=NT, conductivity is A₀/N, and insulated faces satisfy N²q·ν=0.
Initial ϑ₀ has a positive bounded C² extension to R³ that is even in each coordinate and 2L_i-periodic. The uniqueness class is continuous through t_K=0 and C^{2,1} up to the faces at positive times.
Spatial integrals use Euclidean Lebesgue volume, and L² denotes almost-everywhere equivalence classes with the associated integral norm. The conserved energy is ∫ΩNε dx; total entropy is ∫Ωs dx.
Countable Choice AC_ω is assumed through the geometric and measure-theoretic suppliers; unrestricted Choice is not assumed.

load_bearing.statement: For the stated rectangular static box, smooth bounded positive lapse, positive constants, specified exponential material state function, conductivity A₀/N, insulated faces, and positive C² even-periodic initial extension, there is a unique continuous/classical heat solution. It is given by Gaussian convolution for ϑ=NT, satisfies m₀≤ϑ≤M₀, has ∇_aJ^a=0 and u_bf^b=0 for the defined support, conserves ∫ΩNε dx, satisfies d𝒮/dt_K=A₀∫Ω|∇ϑ|²/ϑ² dx≥0, and obeys ‖ϑ(t_K)−ϑ̄‖₂≤exp(−A₀t_K/(C_VC_Ω))‖ϑ₀−ϑ̄‖₂, with C_Ω=(3/2)(max_iL_i)². Consequently T converges in L² to ϑ̄/N, whose inverse-temperature vector is Killing.

For the stated smooth Lorentzian and material-state data with T>0, nonnegative smooth κ, η and ζ_b, X^a=Δ^{ab}(∇_bT+Ta_b), q=−κX, Q=q/c, V=0, Π=−ζ_b cθ, π^{ab}=−2ηcσ^{ab}, particle conservation, stress balance and u_bf^b=0, the entropy current S^a=su^a+Q^a/T satisfies ∇_aS^a=κX^aX_a/(cT²)+2ηcσ^{ab}σ_ab/T+ζ_b cθ²/T≥0.

For a smooth future unit timelike field on an open subset of a smooth time-oriented Lorentzian four-manifold, the defined shear is symmetric, spatial in both indices and trace-free. Its contraction σ^{ab}σ_ab is nonnegative, with equality exactly when σ=0. Every spatial vector Y satisfies g(Y,Y)≥0, with equality exactly when Y=0.

seams_checked.note: Checked the stationary-carrier definition and Killing-normalization lemma against the heat theorem's equilibrium use. The consumer supplies a connected open domain, selected future timelike Killing field and positive equilibrium temperature with NT_eq=ϑ̄. It does not infer Killing inverse temperature for the evolving nonequilibrium profile.

Checked the full dissipative entropy identity and its cancellation proof against the specialization. The consumer retains the same stress and entropy-current conventions, supplies smooth state fields and balances, and explicitly imposes V=0 and u_bf^b=0. The signs and factors of c agree.

Checked the supported-heat postulate and conditional relaxation theorem against the mathematical supplier. Box geometry, state function, conductivity, lapse bounds, compatible initial extension, support, boundary conditions, conserved energy, entropy rate and exponential estimate match. Positive-time smoothness required by the postulate follows from the supplier's actual Gaussian construction. The physical consumer preserves the conditional scope and makes no empirical or causal-evolution claim.
